subject: general
question: Maitrak dynasty was founded in which part of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Western**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Maitrak dynasty was founded in the region of **Western India**.
 
• It primarily ruled over the area of **present-day Gujarat**.
 
• The capital of the Maitrak dynasty was at **Vallabhi**, which is located in the Saurashtra region of Gujarat.
 
• The Maitrakas were known for their contributions to art, culture, and learning during their reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vallabhi University**:

 
 
• The Maitrak dynasty established Vallabhi University, which became a renowned center of learning in ancient India.
 
• It was known for its studies in Buddhism, Jainism, and other Indian philosophies.
 
 
 
• **Founder of Maitrak Dynasty**:
 
 
• The Maitrak dynasty was founded by **Senapati Bhatarka** in the late 5th century.
 
• He was a general under the Gupta Empire before establishing his own kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Religious Influence**:
 
 
• The Maitrakas were patrons of both Hinduism and Buddhism.
 
• They built several temples and stupas, promoting religious harmony.
 
 
 
• **End of the Dynasty**:
 
 
• The Maitrak dynasty came to an end in the 8th century due to invasions by the Arabs.
 
• The last ruler of the dynasty was Siladitya VI.
